notes: Redesigned popup and death timers. The overlay has been rebuilt to look like DDO's own panels — a sleeker rounded frame, a two-column layout so every number lines up on the right, the Power Level shown as a big readout with a confidence bar, and Party HP drawn as a real gauge. New 'Death timers' row: after a death in a raid or reaper quest it shows each party member's remaining death-penalty countdown (whichever of the raid or reaper timer is longer), most-urgent first. The two durations are tunable in the sidebar panel. Also fixes the stale 'Party DPS 44,000 while idle' reading that could show for a moment between fights.
